capabilities: monitor vault sync status in the status bar, side panel, and tab icons
resolve .sync-conflict files with a side-by-side diff view
pause and resume folders and view connected devices
edit .stignore with templates and quick-ignore context menu actions
restore previous file versions using versioning strategies
extras: Full usage guides and troubleshooting are hosted in external documentation; translations are community-maintained on Crowdin; detailed Android HTTPS setup warnings are included.
intentEvidence: This plugin acts as a bridge to your local Syncthing API
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to monitor Syncthing sync status, resolve .sync-conflict files, or edit .stignore from inside the app.
